questions.question: Mission Basundhara 3.0 is primarily associated with which of the following sectors in Assam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Land Revenue and Records.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Launch:** Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma** launched Mission Basundhara 3.0 in Guwahati, continuing the state's flagship initiative for land reforms.
 
• **Evolution:** This is the third phase of the mission, following the successful implementation of Basundhara 1.0 (2021) and Basundhara 2.0 (2023–2024).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Features of Mission Basundhara 3.0__**

__
 
• **New Digital Services:** The portal now allows online application and delivery of land revenue receipts, **land classification certificates**, jamabandi copies, and mouza maps.
 
• **Digital Mutation:** It enables faster **name transfer (mutation)** for inherited or sold land with significantly reduced processing timelines.
 
• **Portal Integration:** The mission is integrated with **Dharitri** (Assam’s land records portal) for real-time verification and updates.
 
• **Specific Land Focus:** Phase 3.0 includes a special focus on the settlement of **tea garden land**, government land settlement, and the removal of encroachments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Technology & Citizen Welfare__**

 
• **Advanced Tech:** The upgraded system uses **GIS mapping, drone surveys**, and **blockchain pilots** to ensure that land records are tamper-proof and highly accurate.
 
• **Paperless Governance:** By using **Aadhaar-linked authentication** and **DigiLocker integration**, the mission promotes a paperless and transparent environment.
 
• **Accessibility:** The government has committed to **doorstep delivery** of services in remote and hilly areas to ensure inclusive governance.
 
• **Accountability:** A grievance redressal mechanism with fixed timelines and **SMS/email tracking** has been established to resolve citizen complaints.

questions.question: Under the revamped Prime Minister Internship Scheme announced in March 2026, what is the new monthly stipend amount provided to interns?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹9,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India announced a major revamp of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme in March 2026 to boost youth employability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial Incentive:** To reduce drop-out rates, the monthly stipend has been increased from **₹5,000 to ₹9,000**.
 
• **Age Revision:** The eligibility age bracket has been widened, with the minimum age reduced to **18 years** and the maximum increased to **25 years**.
 
• **Academic Scope:** The scheme now allows candidates with **Postgraduate and MBA degrees** to apply, which was previously restricted.
 
• **Corporate Base:** The requirement for companies to have **CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility)** mandates has been removed to expand the number of participating firms.
 
• **Target:** Phase 3 of the scheme aims to provide **1,00,000 internship opportunities** across 19 different sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **CSR Mandate__**

__
 
• Corporate Social Responsibility__

 
 
• **CSR** refers to the legal requirement under the Companies Act, 2013, for certain profitable companies to spend 2% of their average net profit on social welfare activities. By removing this as a prerequisite for the internship scheme, the government has enabled smaller but high-growth firms to mentor youth.

questions.question: Regarding the **'Khet Bachao Abhiyan'** reported by the **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)** in May 2026, which of the following statements is **INCORRECT**?

options.text: The campaign is being implemented under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education.
A total of 12,979 awareness camps and seminars have been organized, directly engaging about 7.17 lakh farmers.
The initiative organized 7,928 field demonstrations to promote the intensive application of synthetic chemical pesticides.
The outreach included 1,144 media broadcasts, comprising 944 radio talks and 200 television and digital programmes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The initiative organized 7,928 field demonstrations to promote the intensive application of synthetic chemical pesticides.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)** reported that the nationwide **'Khet Bachao Abhiyan'** has reached **2.71 crore people** across India to promote **sustainable farming**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** The campaign is being implemented under the **Department of Agricultural Research and Education** (DARE).
 
• **Statement 2 is correct:** **12,979 awareness camps** and seminars were organized, which directly engaged approximately **7.17 lakh farmers** on scientific nutrient management.
 
• **Statement 3 is incorrect:** While **7,928 field demonstrations** were indeed organized, their purpose was to provide practical exposure on **green manuring, bio-fertilisers, and organic nutrient sources**, not synthetic chemical pesticides. The campaign actually aims to **reduce excessive dependence** on chemical fertilisers.
 
• **Statement 4 is correct:** The outreach effort was amplified through **1,144 media broadcasts**, which included **944 radio talks** and **200 television and digital programmes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The campaign reached **2.712 crore citizens** through digital and media outreach.
 
• **3,145 training programmes** were conducted with more than **1.11 lakh participants**.
 
• The initiative involved **4,916 Janpratinidhi Sammelans** featuring **Panchayat representatives**, Sarpanches, and Zila Parishad members.
 
• Interaction sessions were held with **9,609 fertiliser and input dealers** to spread awareness about **balanced fertiliser application**.
 
• Banners and posters were displayed at **53,616 locations** across the country.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The primary goal of **'Khet Bachao Abhiyan'** is to encourage **soil test-based nutrient management**.
 
• It seeks to protect **long-term soil fertility** and promote **environmentally sustainable** agricultural practices in India.
 
• Farmer collectives including **FPOs, SHGs, and FIGs** were involved, connecting **8,383 farmer-members**.

questions.question: The Government of India has launched a new Centrally Sponsored Scheme, namely 'New India Literacy Programme' (NILP), for implementation during the five years from FY _____________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1) 2022-23 to 2026-27**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New India Literacy Programme (NILP)** is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme** introduced by the **Government of India**.
 
• The scheme is designed to be implemented during the **five-year period** from **2022-23 to 2026-27**.
 
• NILP aims to promote **literacy and education** across all age groups, focusing particularly on adults who are illiterate.
 
• The programme includes **five key components**: foundational literacy and numeracy, critical life skills, vocational skills development, basic education, and continuing education.
 
• This scheme seeks to address the challenges of illiteracy, improve the quality of life, and contribute to building a **knowledge-based society**.
 
• The implementation will be carried out through coordination between **central and state governments**, ensuring effective resource utilization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objective of NILP:**

 
 
• The programme is aimed at eradicating **adult illiteracy** across the nation.
 
• It emphasizes teaching **foundational literacy**, numeracy, and critical life skills to empower individuals for better participation in civic and economic activities.
 
• The scheme is aligned with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which envisions universal literacy and numeracy by 2030.
 
 
 
• **Key Features:**
 
 
• The scheme will cover **non-literates aged 15 years and above**.
 
• The curriculum includes **digital literacy**, financial literacy, and health awareness to promote holistic development.
 
• Focus areas include **gender equality**, environmental conservation, and vocational skill training.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Details:**
 
 
• NILP will be implemented through **online modes** and face-to-face classes.
 
• Resource materials will be provided in **regional languages** for effective learning.
 
• State governments will play a significant role in identifying beneficiaries and deploying resources.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Addressed:**
 
 
• India has a significant percentage of **adult illiterates**, especially in rural and marginalized communities.
 
• The scheme seeks to improve **educational outcomes** and address socio-economic disparities.
 
• It aims to integrate **technology-enabled learning** to reach remote areas effectively.
 
 
 
• **Funding Details:**
 
 
• The scheme is **centrally sponsored**, with funding shared between the **central and state governments**.
 
• Financial assistance will be provided to states to ensure proper implementation and monitoring.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**

 
 
• The NEP 2020 emphasizes **universal access to education** and aims to achieve foundational literacy and numeracy by **Grade 3**.
 
• It supports **adult education programmes** and lifelong learning as part of building an equitable and inclusive society.
 
 
 
• **Literacy Rates in India:**
 
 
• According to the **National Statistical Office (NSO) 2020 survey**, the literacy rate in India stands at **77.7%**.
 
• There are disparities in literacy rates between **rural and urban areas**, and between genders.
 
 
 
• **Global Perspective:**
 
 
• Adult literacy is a global challenge, with the **UNESCO Education for All (EFA)** initiative aiming to eradicate illiteracy worldwide.
 
• India’s NILP aligns with the **Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4)**, which focuses on quality education and lifelong learning opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Role of Digital Literacy:**
 
 
• Digital literacy is a critical component of NILP, helping individuals access information and improve productivity.
 
• It supports initiatives like **Digital India** to bridge the digital divide in the country.

questions.question: The Vibrant Villages Programme–II (VVP–II) is being implemented across how many States and Union Territories in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**15 States and 2 Union Territories.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Vibrant Villages Programme–II (VVP–II) is being implemented across 15 States and 2 Union Territories in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scheme covers 15 States including Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Gujarat, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Punjab, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Tripura, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal.**
 
• **It also includes 2 Union Territories: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.**
 
• **VVP–II is a Central Sector Scheme with an outlay of ₹6,839 crore up to FY 2028–29.**
 
• **The programme focuses on comprehensive development of villages located along India’s international borders.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Sector Scheme** refers to schemes that are fully funded and implemented by the Central Government.
 
• **Border Villages** are settlements located along India’s international boundaries and are strategically important for national security and regional development.
 
• **Vibrant Villages Programme–I** was launched in 2023 to improve infrastructure, connectivity and livelihood opportunities in border areas.
 
• **Financial Year 2028–29** denotes the accounting period from April 1, 2028 to March 31, 2029.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the extension of Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III), as approved in April 2026, is INCORRECT?

options.text: The scheme has been extended beyond March 2025 and will now continue up to March 2028.
The revised outlay of the scheme is Rs. 83,977 crore, increased from the original outlay of Rs. 80,250 crore.
The timeline for the completion of bridges in hilly areas has been extended until March 2029.
The extension allows for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas until March 2027.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The extension allows for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas until March 2027.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** The Cabinet gave approval for the extension of the **PMGSY-III** scheme beyond its original deadline to continue up to **March 2028**.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct:** The original outlay for the scheme was **Rs. 80,250 crore**, which has now been revised to **Rs. 83,977 crore**.

questions.question: The Smart Sea Project is primarily associated with:

Installation of offshore wind farms under the National Blue Economy Policy
Introduction of hydrogen-powered naval combat vessels

questions.solution:

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN) Scheme is an initiative of which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN) Scheme, earlier known as the Mid-Day Meal Scheme, is implemented by the **Ministry of Education**.
 
• This centrally sponsored scheme aims to provide **nutritious meals to school children studying in government and government-aided schools** across India.
 
• The program benefits children from **Classes 1 to 8**, ensuring they receive adequate nutrition to support their physical and cognitive development.
 
• The scheme covers approximately **11.8 crore children** studying in over 11.2 lakh schools nationwide.
 
• Under PM POSHAN, the government provides **hot cooked meals** to children, improving school attendance, reducing dropout rates, and enhancing overall nutritional status.
 
• The scheme also emphasizes the involvement of local and community stakeholders, including **school management committees**, parents, and local bodies, for effective implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development:**
 
 
• This ministry oversees programs like **Poshan Abhiyaan**, aimed at tackling malnutrition among children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
 
• It implements schemes such as the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)**, which focuses on early childhood care, education, and nutrition.
 
• The ministry plays a pivotal role in policy formulation and implementation for the welfare of women and children in India.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare:**
 
 
• Responsible for health-related programs such as **Ayushman Bharat**, the National Health Mission, and various immunization drives.
 
• It focuses on improving maternal and child health through initiatives like the **Janani Suraksha Yojana** and **Mission Indradhanush**.
 
• The ministry also coordinates efforts to combat malnutrition, anemia, and other health challenges.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture:**
 
 
• This ministry primarily focuses on agricultural development, farmers' welfare, and food security.
 
• It implements schemes such as the **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana**, **Soil Health Card Scheme**, and **PM-KISAN**.
 
• While it indirectly contributes to nutrition through food production policies, it is not directly involved in meal schemes for school children.
 
 
 
• **About PM POSHAN Scheme:**
 
 
• The PM POSHAN Scheme was revamped to incorporate nutrition education, ensuring children develop healthy eating habits.
 
• It includes components such as **millets promotion**, kitchen gardens, and school nutrition awareness.
 
• The scheme is aligned with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** to enhance learning outcomes and holistic development.

questions.question: In which year did the Union Cabinet approve the Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) Scheme, named as ‘Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Cabinet approved the Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) Scheme, titled Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY), on 1st July 2025.
 
• The scheme was initially announced in the Union Budget 2024-25 as part of the "Prime Minister’s Package for Employment and Skilling"
 
• Effective Date: The scheme came into effect on 1st August 2025.
 
• Registration Period: Benefits apply to jobs created between 1st August 2025 and 31st July 2027.
 
• Financial Outlay: It has a total budgetary outlay of ₹99,446 Crore.
 
• Job Creation Target: Aims to incentivize the creation of more than 3.5 Crore jobs over a period of two years.
 
• Implementation: It is managed by the Ministry of Labour & Employment through the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scheme A: First-Time Employees**

 
 
• This component focuses on individuals entering the workforce for the first time in the **formal sector**.
 
• The government provides a **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** of one month’s wage, up to **₹15,000**, paid in **three installments** directly to the employee's **EPFO** account.
 
• The eligibility criteria include a monthly salary of up to **₹1,00,000**, ensuring that a broad range of graduates and diploma holders can benefit.
 
 
 
• **Scheme B: Job Creation in Manufacturing**
 
 
• This scheme specifically targets the **manufacturing sector**, which has high potential for mass employment.
 
• Incentives are provided to both the **employee** and the **employer** with respect to their **EPFO** contributions during the first **four years** of employment.
 
• It aims to encourage companies to scale up their production capacity by reducing the cost of hiring **additional manpower**.
 
 
 
• **Scheme C: Support to Employers**
 
 
• This component is **sector-agnostic** and provides direct support to employers for every additional job created.
 
• The government reimburses the employer's **EPFO contribution** up to **₹3,000** per month for **two years** for each new employee hired.
 
• This incentive is applicable for employees earning a salary up to **₹1,00,000** per month, facilitating job creation in both the **service** and **industrial** sectors.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The scheme is implemented and monitored by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** through the **Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)**, ensuring transparency and direct reaching of benefits.
 
• A key feature of **PM-VBRY** is its focus on **formalization**; it requires beneficiaries to have a **Universal Account Number (UAN)** and be registered on the **e-Shram portal** or **EPFO**.
 
• The scheme aligns with the government’s broader strategy to enhance **Ease of Doing Business** by reducing the financial burden of statutory contributions on small and medium enterprises (**MSMEs**).
 
• By linking incentives directly to **employment generation**, the government aims to bridge the gap between skill development and actual job placement, fostering a more robust **industrial ecosystem** in India.

questions.question: Which of the following services have been integrated into the newly revamped Mission Vatsalya Portal launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development in July 2025?

options.text: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Childline 1098
Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana and Sakhi

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**TrackChild and Khoya-Paya Services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mission Vatsalya Portal** is a comprehensive platform launched by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** to protect and rehabilitate children in need of care and protection.
 
• In **July 2025**, the newly revamped portal integrated several services, including **TrackChild** and **Khoya-Paya**, which are key tools for tracking missing children and ensuring their safety.
 
• **TrackChild**: This initiative is a nationwide tracking system that helps in locating missing children and linking them with their families or providing them institutional care.
 
• **Khoya-Paya Services**: This is an online citizen-based platform to report and track missing and found children, encouraging public participation in child welfare.
 
• Other schemes like **Poshan Abhiyaan**, **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao**, and **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana** are critical government initiatives, but they are not directly integrated into the Mission Vatsalya Portal. *Hence, options 1, 2, and 4 are incorrect.*
 
• The integration of **TrackChild** and **Khoya-Paya** services aligns with the mission's objective of ensuring a safe environment for children and expediting their rehabilitation. *Hence, option 3 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **TrackChild:**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** in partnership with the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• The platform connects stakeholders, including police, child welfare committees, and childcare institutions, to trace missing children.
 
• It features a centralized database of missing and found children, accessible to law enforcement agencies and authorized officials.
 
• Parents and guardians can also register complaints and track updates about their missing children.
 
 
 
• **Khoya-Paya Services:**
 
 
• Launched in **2015** by the Government of India, this citizen-centric platform enables people to report missing or found children.
 
• It serves as a bridge between the public and government authorities, accelerating the process of locating children.
 
• The platform uses technology to disseminate information quickly, increasing the chances of reuniting children with their families.
 
• It complements the **TrackChild** initiative by mobilizing community support for child welfare.
 
 
 
• **Mission Vatsalya:**
 
 
• This is an umbrella scheme aimed at **child protection, welfare, and development**, focusing on children in difficult circumstances.
 
• It emphasizes strengthening the child protection system, institutional care, and non-institutional care, such as adoption and foster care.
 
• The program also promotes awareness and participation among stakeholders and communities to safeguard children's rights.
 
 
 
• **Other Integrated Child Protection Services (ICPS):**
 
 
• ICPS was merged into Mission Vatsalya to create a unified framework for child protection in India.
 
• It includes services like open shelters, child helplines, and sponsorships to aid vulnerable children.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Childline 1098:** This is a toll-free helpline service for children in distress, operational under the Mission Vatsalya framework.
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** This scheme focuses on gender equality and improving the survival and education of the girl child, but it is not directly integrated into the portal.
 
• **Poshan Abhiyaan:** It addresses malnutrition and is aimed at improving the nutritional outcomes for children and women but operates independently of Mission Vatsalya.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana:** A maternity benefit program for pregnant women and lactating mothers, providing conditional cash transfers, but it is separate from the Mission Vatsalya Portal's scope.

questions.question: 'AADHAR' is a programme:

options.text: to train people for social defence
to provide nutritional support to adolescent woman
to provide identity to Indian residents

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**to provide identity to Indian residents**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AADHAR** is a **12-digit unique identity number** that can be obtained voluntarily by the residents of **India** based on their **biometric** and **demographic data**.
 
• The primary objective of the **Aadhar programme** is to provide a **universal identity** to every resident of the country, ensuring that the benefits of **government subsidies** and **services** reach the intended beneficiaries directly. *Hence, statement D is correct.*
 
• The programme is managed by the **Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)**, which was established as a statutory authority under the provisions of the **Aadhaar Act, 2016**.
 
• Unlike other identity documents, **Aadhar** captures both **demographic information** (name, date of birth, gender, address) and **biometric information** (ten fingerprints, two iris scans, and a facial photograph).
 
• The scheme does not specifically aim to help senior citizens as its core function, although they are eligible for it like any other resident. *Hence, statement A is incorrect.*
 
• The programme does not involve training people for social defence or providing nutritional support to adolescent women, which are handled by different ministries and schemes like **SABLA** or **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)**. *Hence, statements B and C are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Context:** The **UIDAI** was initially set up by the **Government of India** in **January 2009**, as an attached office under the aegis of the then **Planning Commission**. The first **Aadhaar** number was issued on **September 29, 2010**, to a resident of **Tembhli village** in **Nandurbar, Maharashtra**.
 
• **Legal Framework:** The **Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016**, provides the legislative backing to the project. It aims to ensure **good governance**, efficient, transparent, and targeted delivery of **subsidies** and **benefits** from the **Consolidated Fund of India**.
 
• **Eligibility and Residency:** Any individual, irrespective of **age** and **gender**, who is a **resident of India** and satisfies the verification process laid down by the **UIDAI** can enroll. A resident is defined as a person who has resided in **India** for a period or periods amounting in all to **182 days or more** in the **12 months** immediately preceding the date of application for enrollment.
 
• **Applications and Uses:** **Aadhar** is used for **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** for various schemes like **PAHAL (LPG subsidy)**, **MGNREGA** wages, and **Old Age Pensions**. It acts as a mandatory document for filing **Income Tax Returns (ITR)** and for the allotment of **Permanent Account Number (PAN)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Data Security:** The **UIDAI** maintains a **Central Identities Data Repository (CIDR)**. To address **privacy concerns**, features like **Virtual ID (VID)** were introduced, which is a temporary, revocable **16-digit random number** mapped with the **Aadhaar** number.
 
• **Supreme Court Ruling:** In the landmark **Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) vs Union of India (2018)** case, the **Supreme Court** upheld the constitutional validity of **Aadhaar** but limited its scope, stating it is not mandatory for opening **bank accounts** or getting **mobile connections**.
 
• **International Recognition:** The **World Bank** and other international organizations have recognized **Aadhaar** as one of the world's most sophisticated **biometric ID systems**, helping **India** save billions of **rupees** by eliminating **ghost beneficiaries** and **leakages** in the **PDS (Public Distribution System)**.
 
• **Baal Aadhaar:** For children below the **age of 5 years**, a blue-colored **Baal Aadhaar** is issued. It does not require **biometrics** at the time of enrollment, but the child is required to update their **biometrics** (facial photograph, iris, and fingerprints) once they reach the **age of 5** and again at the **age of 15**.

questions.question: The Anavaran Portal is related to:

options.text: A satellite-based deforestation alert system used to monitor forest cover loss.
A national digital platform for mapping biodiversity hotspots in India.
A portal used for monitoring wildlife migration using GPS-enabled tracking devices.
A government platform for tracking afforestation projects under CAMPA funds.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Anavaran Portal came into the news after the Forest Survey of India stopped issuing deforestation alerts and the portal’s data had not been updated since November 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Anavaran Portal is a deforestation alert system developed and operated by the Forest Survey of India to monitor forest cover loss using satellite data and machine learning tools. **Hence, option A is correct. **
 
• It sends alerts to State Forest Departments approximately every 15 days so that targeted field inspections can be conducted to verify deforestation events.
 
• The Anavaran Portal is not designed for mapping biodiversity hotspots; its primary function is detecting forest cover loss using satellite imagery. **Hence, option B is incorrect. **
 
• Monitoring wildlife migration using GPS tracking devices is done through wildlife telemetry systems and research projects, not through the Anavaran Portal.** Hence, option C is incorrect. **
 
• Monitoring afforestation projects under CAMPA is carried out through separate monitoring systems related to the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016, not through the Anavaran Portal. **Hence, option D is incorrect. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The alert system is built on the Google Earth Engine platform and uses Sentinel-2 satellite imagery as input data.
 
• Satellite imagery with spatial resolutions of about 10–20 metres is used to detect forest cover changes, including optical and radar-based observations.
 
• The portal relies on machine-learning algorithms to automatically identify potential deforestation events from satellite data.
 
• The system supports near-real-time forest monitoring, enabling quicker response by forest departments to illegal logging or encroachment.
 
• Similar remote sensing systems such as Terra-I have been used internationally (e.g., in Peru) to monitor deforestation using satellite-based alerts.
